rules.name: Monthly basic salary SGD
rules.note: Saved full-month contracted salary in SGD; no FX conversion. August payroll supplies the two active salary baselines.

rules.name: Employee CPF SGD
rules.note: Reviewed full-month employee CPF basis used by the supplied net-before-proration method. Confirm residency, age, PR year and wage ceilings separately. Enter a reviewed zero for an exemption; do not carry an old month forward.

rules.name: Employee self-help contribution SGD
rules.note: Reviewed full-month self-help contribution basis used by the supplied net-before-proration method. Confirm the fund and any valid opt-out separately; zero must be explicit.

rules.name: Employer CPF SGD
rules.note: Actual employer CPF payable for this month, reviewed separately. Added to employer cost without a second proration. Enter zero only when confirmed.

rules.name: SDL employer contribution SGD
rules.note: Preserved client calculation.

rules.note: Preserved client calculation.

rules.name: Net CTC annual SGD

rules.name: Standard working days
rules.note: Agreed standard working days for the selected Singapore month, after public holidays. Must be greater than zero; August uses 20. This is not the Indonesia calendar-day divisor.

rules.name: LOP days
rules.note: Unpaid or inactive working days, including an approved joiner/leaver proration. Enter zero when none; cannot exceed standard working days.

rules.name: Arrear days
rules.note: Approved arrear days at the current salary rate. Use Other income for separately priced backpay. Enter zero when none.

rules.name: Active working days
rules.note: Preserved client calculation.

rules.name: Salary payable SGD
rules.note: Preserved client calculation.

rules.name: Medical allowance SGD
rules.note: Approved cash medical allowance for the selected month. Added after salary proration. A reimbursement needs its correct separate treatment.

rules.name: Other income SGD
rules.note: Approved other cash income for the selected month, added after proration. Explain nonzero bonuses or backpay in Remarks.

rules.name: Net take-home pay SGD
rules.note: Preserved client calculation.

rules.name: Employee ID
rules.note: Same unique canonical value as Employee Code/Badge ID.

source_scope: Rize-only client configuration and employee records. No shared application code changes.
notes: August payroll is the calculation source; the Singapore master supplies canonical employee names, IDs and joining dates.
One joining date differs between the Singapore master and payroll. The master date is retained; the original payroll date remains a separate audit field. August pay is unchanged.
CPF, self-help contributions and employer CPF are reviewed monthly inputs. Never infer CPF residency or an opt-out from a foreign nationality or name.
Proration follows the supplied August net-before-proration formula. SDL uses actual wages; employer remittance is rounded down after summing employee SDL.
Future months require a new period-specific download, reviewed time/contribution inputs and current records. Inactive master profiles are not on the payroll roster.
